definitions.explanation: A humble way to refer to one's own company when speaking or writing to clients, partners, or other external parties. Literally 'small company,' it follows the Japanese convention of self-deprecation in business communication.
Literally, something small denoted by {社|しゃ}: a small company or business, or a small Shinto shrine. Used descriptively rather than as humble self-reference.

examples.japanese: {小社|しょうしゃ}の{製品|せいひん}をご{検討|けんとう}ください。
{小社|しょうしゃ}では{品質管理|ひんしつかんり}に{細心|さいしん}の{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}っております。
examples.english: At our company, we pay the utmost attention to quality control.

examples.japanese: {小社|しょうしゃ}は{創業|そうぎょう}より{五十年|ごじゅうねん}にわたり、お{客|きゃく}さまの{信頼|しんらい}に{応|こた}えてまいりました。
examples.english: For over fifty years since its founding, our company has been dedicated to meeting the trust of our customers.

examples.japanese: {小社|しょうしゃ}ながら{独自|どくじ}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: Although it is a small company, it has unique technology.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}には{小社|しょうしゃ}がいくつかある。
examples.english: There are several small shrines in the town.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{小社|しょうしゃ}でも{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}が{絶|た}えない{神社|じんじゃ}がある。
examples.english: Even among small local shrines, there are some that always have visitors.

notes:
Compound of {小|しょう} ('small') and {社|しゃ} ('company; shrine'). The humble business sense is the primary modern usage, following the Japanese pattern of using {小|しょう} as a self-deprecating prefix: {小生|しょうせい} ('I,' humble, literary), {小著|しょうちょ} ('my book,' humble).

USAGE:
- Sense 1 (humble 'our company') is used in formal business correspondence, emails to clients, and corporate communications
- More formal than {弊社|へいしゃ}, though both are humble; {弊社|へいしゃ} is the more common humble term in modern business
- Sense 2 can mean either a small company or a small Shinto shrine, depending on context

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小社|しょうしゃ}の{製品|せいひん}: our company's products
- {小社|しょうしゃ}では: at our company
- {小社|しょうしゃ}より: from our company
- {小社|しょうしゃ}にて: at our company (written)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弊社|へいしゃ}: our company (humble) — the most common humble term for one's own company in modern business
- {当社|とうしゃ}: our company (neutral) — a neutral reference to one's company, used in internal documents and presentations
- {御社|おんしゃ}/{貴社|きしゃ}: your company (respectful) — used to refer to the other party's company in conversation ({御社|おんしゃ}) or writing ({貴社|きしゃ})
